name: Grassy Expanse
design_intent: Spread-out 3760px grass island (walkable x0..3760, footprint UNCHANGED): two WIDE trampoline floors (x0..1600 / x2160..3760) split by an OPEN ~560px void pit (no bridge), three boost-only elevated pads (bubblegum shoulders + a spring THRONE over the pit). v2 kill-shape (docs/specs/v2_kill_shape_edges.md): the EDGES are now the primary blast zone, the pit is DEMOTED to a minority traversal hazard. Side blast lines pulled into the launch band (left -560 / right 4320 = ~560px runway each side, outside the walkable extent) so a near-edge dead-on super spikes you OFF the screen while a mid-stage knock still arcs back (the recovery gamble). The two edge bumper posts were REMOVED (they reflected outward launches back in, defeating the side blast; no reflector within the 560px near-edge band). The pit is narrowed 960->560 (still > the ~395px zero-boost trampoline drift, so sustained flight stays MANDATORY to cross; a brief boost crosses it), which also WIDENS the floors into a genuine mid-stage safe zone (floor centers x800/x2960 sit ~1360px from the side blast > the ~900px band). Every upper pad beats a spring bounce's 480px apex, so the jetpack is mandatory to climb; super earns the cross-map and the throne. ART-DIRECTOR TODO: the pit must READ as a lethal void (dark chasm / depth / void texture) — it currently paints as safe-field green over the meadow, the CD's biggest felt problem; the JSON schema has no void-marker object, so this needs a renderer/art change (see docs/briefs/cd_verdict2_2026-07-04_killshape.md).
